No, that is not correct. According to Swiss law, there is no automatic upgrade from an L permit to a C permit after five years. The typical path to a C permit involves first obtaining a B permit, which usually requires a minimum of five years of continuous residence in Switzerland with a B permit (or sometimes ten years with an L permit, depending on the canton and individual circumstances).

To obtain a C permit, you generally need to have held a B permit for at least five years and meet additional requirements such as integration (language skills, knowledge of Swiss society, etc.). The five years with an L permit do not count toward the B permit requirement for a C permit. Always check with your cantonal migration office for the most accurate and up-to-date information, as regulations can vary by canton.
